import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_4.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_5.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length6_3/training_6.csv",
]

# Read all source files into a list of DataFrames
dfs = []
for file in source_files:
    # index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column as per instructions
    df = pd.read_csv(file, index_col=0)
    dfs.append(df)

# Concatenate all source DataFrames (UNION)
df_all = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The intermediate_step1.csv already contains the union with the 'Timestamp' column added.
# But since we have all source files, we do the union ourselves.

# Ensure the 'Timestamp' column exists and is string type (as in target)
# If 'Timestamp' column is missing or not string, create/convert it from 'Timestamp [ms]'
if 'Timestamp' not in df_all.columns:
    # Convert 'Timestamp [ms]' to datetime string in format 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'
    df_all['Timestamp'] = pd.to_datetime(df_all['Timestamp [ms]'], unit='ms').dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')
else:
    # Just ensure it's string type
    df_all['Timestamp'] = df_all['Timestamp'].astype(str)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    'Timestamp [ms]',
    'CPU cores',
    'CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [MHZ]',
    'CPU usage [%]',
    'Memory capacity provisioned [KB]',
    'Memory usage [KB]',
    'Disk read throughput [KB/s]',
    'Disk write throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network received throughput [KB/s]',
    'Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]',
    'Timestamp'
]

df_all = df_all[target_columns]

# Cast columns to target types explicitly
df_all['Timestamp [ms]'] = df_all['Timestamp [ms]'].astype(int)
df_all['CPU cores'] = df_all['CPU cores'].astype(int)
df_all['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'] = df_all['CPU capacity provisioned [MHZ]'].astype(float)
df_all['CPU usage [MHZ]'] = df_all['CPU usage [MHZ]'].astype(float)
df_all['CPU usage [%]'] = df_all['CPU usage [%]'].astype(float)
df_all['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'] = df_all['Memory capacity provisioned [KB]'].astype(int)
df_all['Memory usage [KB]'] = df_all['Memory usage [KB]'].astype(float)
df_all['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'] = df_all['Disk read throughput [KB/s]'].astype(int)
df_all['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'] = df_all['Disk write throughput [KB/s]'].astype(float)
df_all['Network received throughput [KB/s]'] = df_all['Network received throughput [KB/s]'].astype(float)
df_all['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'] = df_all['Network transmitted throughput [KB/s]'].astype(float)
df_all['Timestamp'] = df_all['Timestamp'].astype(str)

# Write the final target table to CSV
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length6_3/target_multisource.csv"
df_all.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
